correctness.rationale: PASS: The surface-area integral equals 4π times the square of mean support minus a positive spectral deficit; the identity extends to every convex body by rotational smoothing. Haar Schur orthogonality gives the exact pair covariance δ_l²/(2l+1), yielding the stated finite-n mean and variance. A finite-degree multivariate CLT gives χ²_{2l+1}, while the tail is uniformly controlled in L1 by twice the summable spectral mass. The support and sharp 2/5 bound follow by positivity; independent Gauss-map area quadrature checked l=2 and mixed l=2,4 perturbations and Monte Carlo checked finite and limiting coefficients. Scientific limits: no explicit finite-n CDF or quantitative CLT rate.

value.rationale: PASS: The complete fluctuation spectrum is a natural second-intrinsic-volume statistic for Minkowski averaging in ordinary three-dimensional space; it gives exact errors at every n, a non-Gaussian infinite-dimensional limit, and a sharp, attained isoperimetric-deficit variance inequality with structural equality cases. Its χ² multiplicities reveal geometric shape information invisible to mean width and are not a mere parameter substitution of planar SO(2) Fourier formulas.
